AIS ESPAÑA.- European Tactical Airlift Program Course 26-4 (ETAP-C 26-4).

AIRSPACE RESERVATION

1. GENERAL

The European Tactical Airlift Program Course 26-4 (ETAP-C 26-4) will be held between 09 and 20 November (LIVEX Phase) in the areas defined below, which will be activated via NOTAM 30 days in advance.

2. RESERVED AREAS AND CORRIDORS

In order to establish a more flexible reservation, the airspace has been divided into eight (8) distinct zones.

These areas or corridors shall be classified as TRA. Aircraft not participating in the exercise may only enter active areas with ATC clearance granted by the ATS agency providing air traffic control service, when permitted by tactical coordination with the relevant military agency (ECAO Madrid /Barcelona, Zaragoza APP, or Valladolid TWR).

Within the context of this supplement, the abbreviation TC stands for “transit corridor”.
